test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five people C, D, X, Y and Z each scored different marks in the same test. All scores are in whole numbers only. D scored the second lowest and D's score was 40. X scored more than D but less than the one who scored 45.45 was not the highest score. C's score is an even number. C did not score the least. Y scored 6 marks less than Z. Which of the following can be a possible score of C?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Five people C , D, X , Y and Z each scored different marks in the same test.

all scores are in whole numbers 

**CALCULATION :**

⇒ As, D scores second lowest marks i.e. 40 and X > D but X < 45

⇒ 45&n
